title: Depth map
uploading: Adding {{name}} as the depth map of {{format}}
replacing: Replacing the depth map of {{format}} with {{name}}
needPicture: A picture's depth map must be a picture (PNG, TIFF, EXR…)
needVideo: A video's depth map must be a video of the same length
no3d: This browser can't show 3D (WebGL 2 is off)
removeBody: The file stays in the item's file history.
rangeHint: The preview is stretched over these values; distances on a log scale, so near things stay apart. The file itself is kept as it is.
fromMainHint: Borrowed from the main version, which has the same size.
unreadable: Greenlit couldn't read this file. It can still be downloaded.
mismatchShape: The depth map is {{depth}} and the picture {{picture}}: they won't line up.
mismatchLength: The depth map lasts {{depth}} and the video {{picture}}.
emptyPicture: No depth map yet. Greenlit can make one, or add one made elsewhere: a PNG, TIFF or EXR of this picture (16-bit and floating point files are kept as they are). You can also drop it here.
emptyVideo: No depth map yet. Greenlit can make one, or add a video of the same length made elsewhere. You can also drop it here.

match.none: No picture or video with this name

gen.videoHint: Videos take a while: about half a second per frame on the processor, much less on a graphics card.
gen.stale: Made from an older file of the picture: make it again to match.
gen.started: Making the depth map of {{format}}. It shows here when it’s ready.

gen.startedMany_other: Making {{count}} depth maps. Follow them in Activity.

gen.oldModel: Made with an older model: make it again for a sharper map with real distances.

settings.title: Depth maps
settings.description: Greenlit makes depth maps on this computer: from the viewer, for a selection in the library, or for every new picture and video.
settings.autoOn: Make a depth map for every new upload
settings.autoOnHint: As soon as a picture or video is ready. Uploaded depth maps are kept; Greenlit’s own are made again when the file changes. Brand kits are left out.
settings.kindsHint: Videos take longest: on a graphics card about a tenth of a second per frame, on the processor about half a second.
settings.missingHint: Their main version’s main format. Brand kits are left out.
settings.queued_one: {{count}} depth map waiting or being made
settings.queued_other: {{count}} depth maps waiting or being made
settings.allBody: They are made one at a time in the background (about a second each); follow them in Activity.
settings.allBodyVideos: {{pictures}} take about a second each; {{videos}} take about half a second per frame. They are made one at a time in the background; follow them in Activity.
settings.modelHint: They run on this computer, on its graphics card when it can: nothing leaves it. Each downloads from Hugging Face the first time it’s needed; both may be used commercially.
settings.gpuOn: Both models run on the graphics card: a picture in under a second, a video several times faster than on the processor.
settings.gpuUnused: {{card}} is here but can’t be used: run the CUDA build of Greenlit with the card passed in (docs/DOCKER.md, “Graphics card”).
settings.noGpu: No graphics card Greenlit can use. On the processor a picture takes about a second and a video about half a second per frame.
settings.gpuOff: The graphics card is turned off (GREENLIT_GPU=off).

for.images: Pictures: the cleanest shapes, with real distances in metres
for.videos: Videos: fast enough for every frame

settings.outdated_one: {{count}} depth map made with an older model
settings.outdated_other: {{count}} depth maps made with an older model
settings.outdatedHint: Made before {{model}} was used for pictures. Making them again replaces them; the old files stay in each item’s history.
settings.gpuWebgpu: WebGPU (outside Docker): videos run on the card; MoGe-2 needs more memory than WebGPU gives it, so pictures are made on the processor (a few seconds each). The CUDA build of Greenlit runs both on the card.
